description: Finds episodes of The Holistic Care Podcast: short episodes for parents, teachers and caregivers on children's emotional wellbeing, published in English ('en') and Hindi ('hi'). Examples: 'an episode about a child's anger', 'all Hindi episodes in season 2'. Filter with `language` and `season`; `query` matches every word against the episode title, summary and key question. Each result gives the episode's summary, duration, release date, the episode page (canonical_url) and the YouTube video (video_url). Transcripts and companion guides are not available through this server — link to the episode page instead. Use get_mindfulness_resource with resource_type 'podcast_episode' and an id such as 'PC-S02E03-EN' to fetch one episode.
name: find_podcast_episodes
title: Find podcast episodes
